mapper.insert: INSERT INTO places ( id, place_id, cid, data_id, input_id, title, place_group, category, sub_types, address, destinations, latitude, longitude, verification_radius_meters, plus_code, timezone, phone, website, google_maps_link, review_count, review_rating, reviews_per_rating, thumbnail, images, descriptions, ai_description, ai_references, status, visibility_status, price_range, open_hours, regular, visit_duration_minutes, popular_times, reservations, order_online, menu, complete_address, about, owner, emails, attributes, raw_data, avg_authenticity_score, place_overall_score, adjusted_rating, trust_level, is_jcurve_detected, is_spike_detected, authentic_low_star_count, score_calculated_at, score_sample_count, score_source, last_scraped_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{placeId}, #{cid}, #{dataId}, #{inputId}, #{title}, #{placeGroup,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{category}, COALESCE(#{subTypes,jdbcType=ARRAY,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}::varchar[], '{}'), #{address}, #{destinations}::jsonb, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{verificationRadiusMeters}, #{plusCode}, #{timezone}, #{phone}, #{website}, #{googleMapsLink}, #{reviewCount}, #{reviewRating}, #{reviewsPerRating}, #{thumbnail}, #{images}, #{descriptions}, #{aiDescription}, #{aiReferences}::jsonb, #{status}, #{visibilityStatus,javaType=com.ds.goroute.type.PlaceVisibilityStatus}, #{priceRange}, #{openHours}, #{regular}, #{visitDurationMinutes}, #{popularTimes}, #{reservations}, #{orderOnline}, #{menu}, #{completeAddress}, #{about}, #{owner}, #{emails}, #{attributes}::jsonb, #{rawData}, #{avgAuthenticityScore}, #{placeOverallScore}, #{adjustedRating}, #{trustLevel,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{isJcurveDetected}, #{isSpikeDetected}, #{authenticLowStarCount}, #{scoreCalculatedAt}, #{scoreSampleCount}, #{scoreSource}, #{lastScrapedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE places SET verification_geometry = ST_Multi(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(#{geoJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), 4326)), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE places SET ward_code = #{wardCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, province_code = COALESCE((SELECT province_code FROM wards WHERE code = #{wardCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), province_code), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE places SET sub_types = #{subTypes,jdbcType=ARRAY,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}::varchar[], updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE places p SET ward_code = w.code, province_code = w.province_code FROM wards w WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.latitude IS NOT NULL AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL AND w.is_active = TRUE AND ST_Covers(w.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(p.longitude::float8, p.latitude::float8), 4326))
mapper.select: SELECT ST_Covers(verification_geometry, pt) OR ST_DWithin(verification_geometry::geography, pt::geography, #{accuracyMeters}::float8) FROM places, LATERAL (SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}::float8, #{latitude}::float8), 4326) AS pt) point WHERE id = #{id} AND verification_geometry IS NOT NULL

SELECT ST_IsValid(g) AS valid, ST_IsValidReason(g) AS reason, ST_Area(g::geography) / 1000000.0 AS area_km2, GeometryType(g) AS geometry_type FROM (SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(#{geoJson}), 4326) AS g) s
